title: AWS analysts claim that at least one actor started to exploit the PHP2Shell bugs on October 17, four days prior to the vulnerabilities' public disclosure (Lily Hay Newman/Wired)
summary: Lily Hay Newman / Wired: AWS analysts claim that at least one actor started to exploit the PHP2Shell bugs on October 17, four days prior to the vulnerabilities' public disclosure — Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago.
